description: A modular orchestration system for managing memory-aware, topic-specific LLMs coordinated through a central instance. Designed to maximize context retention, token efficiency, and adaptive collaboration across assistants.

modules.name: Charlar (Central LLM Coordinator)
modules.purpose: Holds user-facing memory, coordinates tasks across assistants, manages heuristic memory retention.
features: Heuristic memory of user preferences and long-term context

modules.name: Bitwise (Programming Assistant)
modules.purpose: Handles all code writing, refactoring, and logic implementation tasks.
features: Works from structured seeds and project files
Communicates with Charlar via structured deltas
Uses semantic tagging of token streams
Assists with CLI tooling, APIs, and Python workflows

modules.name: Schematicus (System Documentation Agent)
modules.purpose: Maintains architecture, sequence diagrams, and documentation from project structure.
features: Coordinates with TalkyToaster for updates based on project actions

modules.name: Logimus (Logging Agent)
modules.purpose: Captures system activity logs, assistant deltas, and execution notes.
features: Writes structured logs (API events, assistant updates, seed changes)

modules.name: TalkyToaster (Coordinator Assistant, Non-LLM)
modules.purpose: Non-LLM routing and sync controller. Handles assistant communication, file handshakes, and orchestration logic.
features: Coordinates sync jobs, reseeds, and memory updates
Manages assistant delta and context_bundle workflows

workflow_summary.task_assignment: Charlar decides and routes to Bitwise, Schematicus, or others
workflow_summary.LLM_response: Response is logged by Logimus and, if structural, sent to Schematicus
workflow_summary.memory_sync: TalkyToaster coordinates context updates between agents
workflow_summary.fallback_support: Fallback assistant model advisory logic available

file_conventions.scripts: scripts/ for CLI tooling and automation

next_steps: Refactor seed sync delta logic to support memory diff by topic
Implement GitHub Actions for CI sync logs
Refine context_bundle tagging strategy for nested agents
Implement semantic garbage collection for old context
